title: alnus incana var. glauca
intro: Alnus incana var. glauca, commonly known as Grey Alder, is a variant of the Alder tree, known for its distinctive silvery-gray bark and cones. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in the treatment of various ailments such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The Grey Alder's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate blood flow, reduce swelling, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which have been identified through scientific research and analysis.
